newsitem.title: JAPAN: Rapid exchange rate changes undesirable - Kajiyama.
newsitem.headline: Rapid exchange rate changes undesirable - Kajiyama.

text.p: A rapid change in foreign exchange rates is undesirable, Japan's government spokesman, Seiroku Kajiyama, said on Tuesday.
Kajiyama said that the long-term interest rate differential between the United States and other countries was behind the yen's recent decline, adding that the German mark was also weakening.
He said that the recent fluctuations in currency rates were due to dollar strength rather than yen weakness.
"In any case, rapid change in exchange rates is undesirable," he said.
Kajiyama was speaking at a regular news conference.
